target: UTM-bundled QEMU framework, HVF, one vCPU, VirtIO input and WAV-backed virtio-sound-pci
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device -audiodev wav,id=sound0,path=build/ohgreat-current-55719.wav -device virtio-sound-pci,audiodev=sound0' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-ohgreat-audio-current-55719.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-demo-ohgreat-full
checks: The original song played through its late lyric, accepted a normal key to exit, and restored the graphical terminal; zstatus reported failed=0.
WAV capture contains 49.22 seconds of stereo 16-bit PCM at 44.1 kHz, with 4,337,678 nonzero samples, RMS 6902.52, and peak 7000.
scope_note: Verifies PCM generation and app/shell recovery on this exact ISO. It is not a live UTM audible playback check; the user's earlier report of Oh Great playing through Pi HDMI was for an image whose hash was not recorded.
